title: Cancellation Terms for Northgate Optical Eyewear Jobs
content:
**Northgate Optical eyewear jobs may be cancelled only before the eyewear is ready.** A job is cancelled from the ordered status (not yet submitted to the lab) or from the in-lab status; the cancellation closes the job, and the cancellation date is recorded as its closing date. Ready or dispensed eyewear is not cancelled; it is returned under the satisfaction return terms.

### Term 1 — Cancellation before the lab

A job not yet submitted to the lab is cancelled with every charge credited in full as a cancellation refund, because every lens design refunds a job cancelled before lab submission in full.

### Term 2 — Cancellation while in the lab

The former term under which a job cancelled while in the lab kept the design's in-lab retained percentage of its original lens charges (the base-lens, material upgrade, anti-reflective, light-adaptive and blue-light filtering charges of the original job, each net of credits, with the retained amount rounded to the cent), because the lenses are already being cut to the prescription, and under which the frame, which returns to stock, and the rest of the lens charges were credited, is **no longer in force**. It is superseded by the current in-lab cancellation basis.

### Term 3 — Every refund against its own charge

Every refund credit is posted against the exact charge it returns and never exceeds that charge's net — the charge less every credit already posted against it — so a vision plan allowance already credited is not refunded to the member a second time.

## Term 3 applied (hypothetical figures)

| Charge | Amount | Credits already against it | Net | Most a refund of it can be |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Frame | 150.00 | insurance allowance 130.00 | 20.00 | 20.00 |
| Base lenses | 99.99 | insurance allowance 44.99 | 55.00 | 55.00 |
| Anti-reflective coating | 35.00 | none | 35.00 | 35.00 |

Under Term 1, a job with exactly these charges cancelled before the lab receives cancellation refunds of 20.00, 55.00 and 35.00, each against its own charge — 110.00 in all.

## Status check

| Job status | Cancellation |
|---|---|
| ordered | cancelled under Term 1 |
| in lab | cancelled while in the lab |
| ready for pickup, dispensed | not cancelled; returned under the satisfaction return terms |
